display.name: Cluster - Memory Pressure
display.description: The pressure is indicating if workloads are waiting for memory.

spec.query: sum(rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"$node"}[1m]))
sum(rate(node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total{instance=~"$node"}[1m]))

display.name: Physical memory utilization & requests
display.description: This is showing the total system utilization (split between virt and non virt workloads). In addition the current plan (requests) are shown in order to to show how much available memory the scheduler is seeing.

spec.query: sum(x_kube_node_status_capacity_memory_by_role)
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{temperature="hot", node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})

sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{temperature="hot", node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"}) - sum(kubevirt_vmi_memory_used_bytes{node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})

x_kube_node_status_system_reserved_memory_by_role
+
sum(kube_pod_resource_request{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

display.name: Cluster Utilization
display.description: The virtual memory assignment is showing the worst-case scenario if all virtual memory was used right now. The assigned virtual memory is shown on top of the non virtualization related memory utilization. The current utiliztaion plus worst-case virtual memory utilization is indiacting the worst case memor overcommittment.

spec.query: sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="system"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", tier="0", utilized="true", usage="overflow"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"}) > 0
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", tier="0", temperature="hot", utilized="true"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", tier="0", temperature="warm", utilized="true"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", tier="0", utilized="false"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", tier="2", temperature="warm", utilized="true"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"}) > 0
sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", tier="2", utilized="false"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"}) > 0
sum(openshift:vm:memory:virtual_committed:bytes and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})

display.name: Cluster Utilization
display.description:
This panel is providing the aggregated memory utilization of all nodes of the cluster. This value is more helpful, the more balanced the memory utilization of all nodes is.
Keep it green.

spec.query: sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{utilized="true", scope="workloads"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"}) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})

display.name: Virtual Memory assignment
display.description: The virtual memory assignment is showing the worst-case scenario if all virtual memory was used right now. The assigned virtual memory is shown on top of the non virtualization related memory utilization. The current utiliztaion plus worst-case virtual memory utilization is indiacting the worst case memor overcommittment.

spec.query: sum(x_kube_node_status_capacity_memory_by_role)

sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{temperature="hot", node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
-
x_kube_node_status_system_reserved_memory_by_role
+
sum(kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes{node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})

sum(openshift:node:memory:bytes{temperature="hot", node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
-
sum(kubevirt_vmi_memory_used_bytes{node=~"$node"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})

display.name: Cluster Virtual Commited
display.description: This panel shows the amount of committed virtual memory as a percentage of the allocatable physical memory. Overcommit occurs whenever the values goes beyond 100%.

spec.query: sum(openshift:vm:memory:virtual_committed:bytes and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"}) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
sum by (instance) (rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"$node"}[1m]))
topk(1, (sum by (instance) (rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{instance=~"$node"}[1m]@end()))))

sum by (node) (kube_pod_resource_request{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

/ on (node)

(
(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"})
)

min(
sum by (node) (kube_pod_resource_request{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

/ on (node)

(
(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"})
)
)

max(
sum by (node) (kube_pod_resource_request{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

/ on (node)

(
(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"})
)
)

display.name: Issues
display.description: This panel provides the precentage of nodes where core system (hypervisor) components are utilizing more than reserved memory. This should not happen, and is specifically critical for clusters under load. Keep it green.

spec.query: count(ALERTS{alertname="SystemMemoryExceedsReservation"}) > 0
count(ALERTS{alertname="TargetDown", job="kube-state-metrics"}) > 0
count(up{job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"} == 0) > 0
(count(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) - count(sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes))) > 0

min (
(
sum by (node) (container_memory_rss{id="/system.slice"})

/ on (node)

(
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_capacity_memory_by_role)
-
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_allocatable_memory_by_role)
)
)
)

max(
sum by (node) (container_memory_rss{id="/system.slice"})

/ on (node)

(
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_capacity_memory_by_role)
-
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_allocatable_memory_by_role)
)

)

display.name: Utilization - Utilization of reserved system memory
display.description: This graph is showing the utilization of the hypervisor system reserved memory. The utilization must stay below 100%, otherwise the hypervisor is using more memory for system processes then what was reserved. This is putting system processes at risk.

spec.query:
topk(5, (
sum by (node) (container_memory_rss{id="/system.slice"})

/ on (node)

(
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_capacity_memory_by_role)
-
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_allocatable_memory_by_role)
)
))

sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", temperature="hot"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role", node=~"$node"}) / on (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"})

max(sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", temperature="hot"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role", node=~"$node"}) / on (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"}))

display.name: Node Utilization - min
display.description: This panel is showing the node memory utilization of the node with the lowest memory utilization in the cluster.

spec.query: min(sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", temperature="hot"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role", node=~"$node"}) / on (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"}))
count(kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes)

min((sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", temperature="hot"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role", node=~"$node"}) + sum by (node) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes)) / on (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"}))

max((sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes{scope="workloads", temperature="hot"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role", node=~"$node"}) + sum by (node) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes)) / on (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"}))

(
(
sum by (node) (openshift:node:memory:bytes{utilized="true", node=~"$node"} )
- on (node)
(
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_capacity_memory_by_role)
-
sum by (node) (x_kube_node_status_allocatable_memory_by_role)
)
)
+
sum by (node) (0-kubevirt_vmi_memory_used_bytes + kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes)
)


/

(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"} * on (node) kube_node_role{role="worker"})

display.name: VM overcommit ratio
display.description: Any value larger than 1 shows that the VM is using more memory than it requested

display.name: VM virtual memory utiliztaion vs host vm urilization

spec.query: avg(openshift:vm:memory:overcommit:ratio and on (node) kube_node_role{role=~"$role"})
